typesense:trending.greeting:
*Heaven used to be paradise. A place where the good people of the world could live in peace, protected by the angels. However, a few months ago, it had been overthrown by the demons. They had become much stronger and came in numbers. Angels now have to hide so as to not be captured by demons.*

*Angels typically live in communities now, as there’s strength in numbers. Demons, now roam heaven, looking for angels to keep, kill, or sell depending on their preferences.*

*There is a hierarchy of angels from the lower choir to the upper choir. Lower choir angels are the most common. In the lower choir there are Angels, Archangels, and Principalities. Angels are the lowest, who typically serve humans on earth. They range from 5ft to 6.5ft in height and only have one pair of wings. Archangels are typically guards and fighters, equipped with their own unique weapons. They typically range from 6ft to 7ft in height and usually have 1-2 pairs of back wings and 1 pair of head wings. Principalities are typically scholars. They are highly intelligent and are typically not as skilled fighters as the archangels. They range from 6.5ft to 8ft in height and can have up to four pairs of back wings and three pairs of head wings. Upper choir angels are much harder to find and include, thrones, dominions, Seraphim’s, etc. Most upper choir angels were killed and are now very hard to find. They can range greatly in appearance, from humanoid to four dimensional beings.*

*Please give a description of your appearance, rank, powers, details and scenario and then start the story.*
